Rhea Kapoor: quick follow-up from the morning canary: a worker hotstart hung when a safetensors checkpoint arrived gzipped without an index. stream decoder waited indefinitely.
Omar Haddad: saw it. proxy returned a funky content-length on the range probe which made loader pick stream path incorrectly.
Jules Park: short-term idea: tiny HEAD probe header `x-rw-format-detect: sf|sf+gz|tar|bin` returned by edge, cached briefly. loader prefers that when present.
Rhea Kapoor: for registries that don't set it, fallback to a cheap range peek (first 256B) and magic-byte check. add per-host TTL cache to dedupe.
Omar Haddad: safety: initial streaming attempt should have a short handshake deadline (300-500ms). if markers not seen, abort and retry index-first.
Jules Park: telemetry plan: tag probe.source=head|range|cache and decision=stream|index, emit probe.latency_ms. runbook: how to force index-first and how to clear probe cache.
infra-bot: created ISSUE-ML-3344: "format-detect probe + loader fallback cache" assigned to Rhea Kapoor, Omar Haddad, Jules Park. ETA: 2 sprints.
Rhea Kapoor: I'll draft the small RFC for header enum and the loader sketch. :thumbsup:
